line-1.text: Hi Emma! What book are you reading on your tablet right now?

line-2.text: I am reading a science fiction story about space travel. What book genre do you like most, Alex?

line-3.text: I really love mystery novels. I like trying to solve the puzzle before the ending!

line-4.text: That sounds fun! But I notice you always carry a thick paper book. Why not use an e-reader?

line-5.text: Because physical books give me a calm experience. I love the smell of paper, and I can rest my eyes from screens.

line-6.text: I see! For me, a digital e-reader is very light and easy to hold. I can carry fifty books on the train every morning.

line-7.text: That is true! So our different habits change how we enjoy reading. I read to slow down, and you read anywhere on the go.

line-8.text: Exactly! The stories are magical, whether they are printed on paper or shown on a screen.
